orgDesign.companyProfile: Typical mid-size local classifieds marketplace with broad category coverage, high casual-seller volume, a meaningful professional merchant business, and shared trust and platform services.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Customer-facing teams own buyer, seller, merchant, and trust journeys, while platform and intelligence teams provide reusable search, data, identity, transaction, and software-development AI-agent foundations.
designPrinciples: Separate buyer, casual seller, and professional seller loops because their optimization levers differ materially.
Treat trust, identity, and protected transactions as a shared marketplace control function.
Keep market intelligence and pricing close to discovery, listing quality, and monetization decisions.

Deploy AI agents only as bounded software-development assistants for backend implementation, frontend implementation, QA automation, code review, test planning, and release risk analysis; keep human approval on merges, releases, production changes, and customer-visible behavior.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for major marketplace value streams and keep a small number of teams per stream.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
